quizTitle: Module 2: The DevNet Developer Environment PDF

questions.text: What is the module objective of Module 2: The DevNet Developer Environment?
options: Implement a development environment using DevNet resources
Build a REST API from scratch using Python
Configure Cisco routers and switches from the command line
Pass the DevNet Associate certification exam
questions.explanation: Slide “Module Objectives”: the module objective is to implement a development environment using DevNet resources.

questions.text: Match each topic of Module 2 to its topic objective.
allChoices: Explain how DevNet encourages communities of network programmers.

pairs.match: Explain how DevNet encourages communities of network programmers.

questions.explanation: Slide “Module Objectives”: DevNet Overview — explain how DevNet encourages communities of network programmers. Exploring DevNet Online Resources — investigate DevNet online resources.

questions.text: According to “What is DevNet?”, DevNet is best described as…
options: A Cisco router operating system for programmable networks
A fully-integrated developer program comprising a website, an interactive developer community, coordinated developer tools, integrated discussion forums, and sandboxes
A paid certification exam for network engineers
A single code editor that Cisco ships with its devices
questions.explanation: Slide “What is DevNet?”: DevNet is a fully-integrated developer program comprising a website, an interactive developer community, coordinated developer tools, integrated discussion forums, and sandboxes.

questions.text: Match each DevNet feature listed in “What is DevNet?” to its description.
allChoices: Self-paced tutorials that cover topics from basic coding to using REST APIs with various technologies
Production-like development and testing environments for a host of technologies
A repository of sample code written by other developers
Support for developer related issues through tickets, live chats, and forums
A central location for all of the product developer API documentation

pairs.match: Self-paced tutorials that cover topics from basic coding to using REST APIs with various technologies
Production-like development and testing environments for a host of technologies
A repository of sample code written by other developers
Support for developer related issues through tickets, live chats, and forums
A central location for all of the product developer API documentation

questions.explanation: Slide “What is DevNet?” lists the five features: Learning Labs (self-paced tutorials), Sandboxes (production-like dev/test environments), Code Exchange (sample code by other developers), Developer support (tickets, live chats, forums) and Developer documentation (central location for all product developer API docs).

questions.text: DevNet Learning Labs are live, instructor-led classes that run on a fixed schedule.
questions.explanation: Slide “What is DevNet?”: Learning Labs are self-paced tutorials covering topics from basic coding to using REST APIs with various technologies.

questions.text: Which DevNet feature gives you production-like development and testing environments for a host of technologies?
questions.explanation: Slide “What is DevNet?”: Sandboxes are production-like development and testing environments for a host of technologies.

questions.text: According to “What is DevNet?”, through which channels does DevNet's developer support handle developer related issues? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “What is DevNet?”: Developer support provides support for developer related issues through tickets, live chats, and forums.

questions.text: To get an overview of DevNet, visit the DevNet Home page at ___ (write the address without https://).
questions.explanation: Slide “Getting Started with DevNet Resources”: to get an overview of DevNet, visit the DevNet Home page at developer.cisco.com.

questions.text: According to “Getting Started with DevNet Resources”, DevNet provides developers a starting point for…
options: All Cisco APIs, including API documentation, education, and developer support
questions.explanation: Slide “Getting Started with DevNet Resources”: DevNet provides developers a starting point for all Cisco APIs, including API documentation, education, and developer support. The summary slide repeats it: DevNet provides developers with a starting point for all Cisco APIs.

questions.text: Which of these does the DevNet Home page offer, according to “Getting Started with DevNet Resources”? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “Getting Started with DevNet Resources”: the site offers Start Now, Learning Tracks, Video Course, Sandbox, Code Exchange and Ecosystem Exchange. A hardware store and a job board aren't on the list.

questions.text: According to “DevNet Learning Labs”, the tutorials cover engineering technologies, programming languages, and concepts such as… (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Learning Labs”: tutorials cover engineering technologies, programming languages, and concepts such as model-driven programmability, REST APIs, Python, and JavaScript.

questions.text: In “DevNet Learning Labs”, a DevNet Sandbox is described as…
options: A pre-configured environment that is already installed with Cisco platforms
An empty virtual machine you must install Cisco software on yourself
A discussion forum for posting code snippets
A downloadable PDF of the API documentation
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Learning Labs”: Learning Labs provide a walk-through for using a DevNet Sandbox — a pre-configured environment that is already installed with Cisco platforms.

questions.text: Besides tutorials and Sandbox walk-throughs, what else do DevNet Learning Labs enable you to do? (Select all that apply.)
options: Set up a development environment for practicing tasks on a local computer
Mimic the overall DevNet site using tutorials on coding, collaboration, IoT, data centre, mobility, and networking
Log a one-on-one support case with a one business day response time
Browse over 1,500 solutions across industries and geographies
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Learning Labs”: Learning Labs also enable you to set up a development environment (for practicing tasks on a local computer) and mimic the overall DevNet site (tutorials on coding, collaboration, IoT, data centre, mobility and networking). Support cases belong to Developer Support, and the 1,500+ solutions are the Ecosystem Exchange.

questions.text: In the Learning Labs tutorial areas (coding, collaboration, IoT, data centre, mobility, networking), what does mobility refer to?
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Learning Labs”: the tutorial areas include “mobility (mobile and wireless)”.

questions.text: According to “DevNet Sandbox”, what do DevNet's sandboxes enable?
options: Hands-on exploration of software and APIs
Purchasing Cisco hardware at a discount
Hosting a production website for free
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Sandbox”: DevNet offers a host of sandboxes that enable hands-on exploration of software and APIs.

questions.text: The multiple ways DevNet provides for community members to share with each other are called ___.
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Exchanges”: DevNet provides multiple ways for community members to share with each other. These are called Exchanges.

questions.text: Match each DevNet Exchange to what it provides.
allChoices: A collection of network automation use cases with different solutions and toolkits
A repository of source code or tools, categorized using the GitHub API and human moderators
Over 1,500 solutions across different technologies, industries, and geographies to begin solution design and development

pairs.match: A collection of network automation use cases with different solutions and toolkits
A repository of source code or tools, categorized using the GitHub API and human moderators
Over 1,500 solutions across different technologies, industries, and geographies to begin solution design and development

questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Exchanges”: Automation Exchange — network automation use cases with different solutions and toolkits. Code Exchange — repository of source code or tools, using the GitHub API and human moderators to categorize and display hundreds of related repositories. Ecosystem Exchange — over 1,500 solutions across different technologies, industries, and geographies.

questions.text: Code Exchange categorizes and displays hundreds of related repositories using human moderators and…
options: Machine learning only, with no human review
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Exchanges”: Code Exchange uses the GitHub API, as well as human moderators, to categorize and display hundreds of related repositories.

questions.text: How many solutions can you find in the Ecosystem Exchange?
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Exchanges”: in the Ecosystem Exchange, one can find over 1,500 solutions across different technologies, industries, and geographies.

questions.text: According to “Find a Use Case in Automation Exchange”, which network automation use cases does the Automation Exchange provide? (Select all that apply.)
options: Activating policies across domains, users, or devices
questions.explanation: Slide “Find a Use Case in Automation Exchange”: the use cases include listing of data, adding configurations, and activating policies across domains, users, or devices.

questions.text: The Automation Exchange listings are for different tool sets, such as…
questions.explanation: Slide “Find a Use Case in Automation Exchange”: the listings are for different tool sets such as Ansible or Puppet.

questions.text: Which infrastructure scenarios are the Automation Exchange listings organized for? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “Find a Use Case in Automation Exchange”: the infrastructure scenarios are Campus or Branch, Data Centre, and Service Provider.

questions.text: According to “DevNet Developer Support”, what can DevNet developer support help troubleshoot?
options: Integrations, API connections, and other specialty questions about developer use cases on Cisco products
Questions about any vendor's products, not just Cisco's
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support”: DevNet offers developer support and can help troubleshoot integrations, API connections, and other specialty questions about developer use cases on Cisco products.

questions.text: For more information on DevNet developer support, visit developer.cisco.com/___.
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support”: visit the website developer.cisco.com/support for more information.

questions.text: According to “DevNet Developer Support”, one can get support by… (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support”: one can get support by logging a ticket, posting to a community forum, or accessing a WebEx Teams space.

questions.text: Match each DevNet Developer Support resource to its description.
allChoices: Consists of troubleshooting articles for reference
A case-based ticket used for one-on-one support with a response time of one business day
Community forums, viewed at https://devnetsupport.cisco.com by clicking Community

pairs.match: Consists of troubleshooting articles for reference
A case-based ticket used for one-on-one support with a response time of one business day

pairs.term: Forums in the Cisco Developer Community
pairs.match: Community forums, viewed at https://devnetsupport.cisco.com by clicking Community

questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support (Contd.)”: Knowledge Base — troubleshooting articles for reference. Support Case — case-based ticket for one-on-one support, response time of one business day. Forums in the Cisco Developer Community — visit https://devnetsupport.cisco.com and click Community.

questions.text: What is the response time of a DevNet Support Case?
options: There is no response — it's a self-help article
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support (Contd.)”: a Support Case is a case-based ticket used for one-on-one support with a response time of one business day.

questions.text: The DevNet Knowledge Base is a case-based ticket used for one-on-one support.
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support (Contd.)”: the Knowledge Base consists of troubleshooting articles for reference. The one-on-one, case-based ticket is the Support Case.

questions.text: To view the community forums in the Cisco Developer Community, which site do you visit before clicking Community?
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Support (Contd.)”: to view community forums, visit https://devnetsupport.cisco.com and click Community.

questions.text: Which objectives are part of the lab “Explore DevNet Resources”? (Select all that apply.)
options: Part 1: Find and Navigate a Learning Lab
Part 3: Build a REST API in Python
questions.explanation: Slide “Lab – Explore DevNet Resources”: the lab has two parts — Part 1: Find and Navigate a Learning Lab, and Part 2: Explore More Resources.

questions.text: According to the module summary, DevNet's online resources include… (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Slide “DevNet Developer Environment Summary”: online resources include DevNet Learning Labs, DevNet video courses, DevNet Sandbox, DevNet Exchanges, and extensive DevNet Support.
